evals.name: list-and-cat-with-connection-check
evals.prompt: Check Draft status, list pages, and read one page for review.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs draft status --json, restores readiness with draft start-server when offline, then uses draft page ls --json and draft page cat <id> to return the page in markdown for review.
expectations: Agent starts by running draft status --json
Agent runs draft start-server only when status indicates the daemon is offline
Agent reads a specific page with draft page cat <id> for markdown review

evals.name: create-and-append-with-connection-check
evals.prompt: Create a new Draft page called 'Sprint 42 Retro' and add three bullet points. Check readiness first.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs draft status --json first, restores readiness with draft start-server if needed, creates the page with draft page create --json, captures the page ID from JSON, then appends markdown bullets with draft page append --json.
expectations: Agent starts by running draft status --json
Agent creates page with draft page create 'Sprint 42 Retro' --json
Agent appends content using draft page append <id> --json

evals.name: secret-share-open-hosted-read
evals.prompt: Read this Draft Secret Share link: https://draft.innosage.co/#/secret/secret-123. The password is 1234.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes the link as a hosted Secret Share read, skips draft status and draft start-server, and runs draft secret open 'https://draft.innosage.co/#/secret/secret-123' --password '1234' --json.
expectations: Agent uses draft secret open <secret-url-or-id> for Secret Share URLs
Agent does not run draft status before hosted Secret Share reads
Agent does not use draft page cat or draft page ls for /#/secret/<id> URLs

evals.name: secret-share-create-hosted-write
evals.prompt: Create a Secret Share from docs/brief.md that expires in 1 hour.
evals.expected_output: Agent skips draft status and draft start-server, ensures a Secret Share API key is available, then runs draft secret create --file docs/brief.md --expires 1h --json.
expectations: Agent does not run draft start-server for Secret Share creation
Agent ensures a Secret Share API key is available
Agent runs draft secret create --file docs/brief.md --expires 1h --json

evals.name: auth-set-key-status
evals.prompt: Configure the Draft Secret Share API key and confirm that it is stored.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs draft auth set-key <secret-share-api-key> followed by draft auth status --json without starting the Draft daemon.
expectations: Agent does not run draft start-server for auth commands
